card.name: Dosing headings in tables and all-caps
card.fires_on: Words in dosing and administration headings, often in all caps or table headers, such as DILUTION, DOSING, Dose Modification and ADMINISTRATION. It fires where the heading is about to be followed by instructions.

modes.label: All-caps heading words
modes.description: Partway through capitalized words like DILUTION, DOSING or ADMINISTRATION in instruction headings.

modes.label: Dose table headers
modes.description: Header cells in dosing tables that name a dose, its timing, or its modification.
modes.example: Dose<< Modification>> for BRAFTOVI New Primary M

card.writes: Promotes words meaning guide and guidance, suggesting the text that follows gives directions.
card.plain: It lights up on dosing and administration headings that introduce instructions on how to give the drug.
